_comment: Allowlist for scripts/trust-claim-sweep-checklist.sh. Each entry suppresses a matching gate fire and is a COUNTDOWN: once the workspace Cargo.toml version exceeds `expiresAfter`, the entry is STALE and the gate fails LOUD (EXPECTED-FAILURE-EXPIRED). Auto-discovered when the gate runs without --expected-failures. Resolve each surface before its expiresAfter; never let an entry outlive its window.
